Response to comments:
STATEMENT J
U.S. DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR
1. Historical interests have been cleared with state and county historical societies. Please see Statements A and B.
2. Please see pages 52, 55, 108, 109, and 137.
3. "Unused Open Lands" has been changed to "Undeveloped Lands". The retention of open space as "a valuable resource in metropolitan areas" is under jurisdiction of park commissions. The Milwaukee County Park Commission has established its plans and does not find this proposed facility to be in conflict with them. Further, the land use trends are conforming to the established plans which envision development as a priority over non-use. See "Land Use Inventory" pages 63 and 86.
4. Loss of agricultural lands is in conformance with the established SEWRPC land use plans. This is an urban area.
5. All lands acquired by the proposed facility which are not needed for actual construction of the freeway will be landscaped. The Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources' District Director has shown a preference that Wisconsin DOT initiate and design their own urban highway landscaping program.
6. In view of this particular project the loss of resources for highway construction is small and, in our opinion, a reasonable statement.
